fields.quote: SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 13, 2026 — CONFIRMED RESULTS ... Four matches were played on Sunday as the new campaign got underway
fields.note: The season article gives only 'Dates: September 2026 – May 2027', so the day comes from the league's own press release: opening day was Sunday 13 September 2026. The kickoff had been moved twice (23 August, then mid-September), which is why the earlier August date found in news is stale. Single 14-team table, no Apertura/Clausura split.
Infobox gives the closing month only (May 2027); no exact last round or final date is published. 39 regular-season matches then playoffs, so the season does not end on a fixed league date.
